title: Unified keyboard flow and aria-label strategy for Rollouts & Insights panels
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Deliver a cohesive keyboard navigation experience and consistent ARIA labeling pattern across the Rollouts panel and Insights/Cost views so keyboard-only and assistive tech users can complete common flows (create rollout, view cost breakdown, switch models, open traces) without missing state changes. This ticket scopes the design spec, prototype, and a lightweight QA checklist for engineering. Work focuses on: 1) explicit focus order and visible focus ring token mapping; 2) 'skip to' anchors for deep charts and long rollouts lists; 3) ARIA roles/labels for interactive cards, dropdowns and expandable rows; 4) locale-safe label lengths and number/date formatting considerations for i18n; 5) contrast improvements for muted tokens in dense cost tables. Deliverables: Figma prototype, confluence spec, dev-friendly token mapping table, small e2e keyboard test plan.
acceptance_criteria: Users can tab through Rollouts list and activate primary actions with Enter/Space in documented order
All interactive elements in Insights and Cost cards have descriptive aria-labels and role semantics validated by VoiceOver/NVDA tests
Contrast for all foreground/background combinations meets WCAG 2.1 AA (1.4.3) for normal text; a contrast ramp is provided for compact density mode
Locale examples (fr, de, ja, ar) included in prototypes; axis ticks and tooltips show locale-aware numbers/dates
Design tokens updated and a migration note added for frontend to avoid breaking changes
